## Invitations

The outreach campaign invited 2348 people during the quarter. Attendance totalled 383, representing a rate of 16.3 per cent. This result provides a clear indication of engagement with the invitation process and supports continued review of how invitations are issued and followed up.

SMS was used as the principal contact method and reached 1995 invitees. Reminder activity was recorded as 0. The available figures should be considered together when reviewing attendance, contact coverage and opportunities to improve participation.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This helped preserve outreach access across the Hill Counties, while recognising that local travel conditions affected delivery.

## Contact

Contact arrangements combined SMS communication with in-person outreach. The SMS reach of 1995 invitees provided broad coverage, while the attendance figure of 383 records the number who took part. No additional reminder activity was recorded, with reminders remaining at 0.
